Stock market news | Indian Rupee Inflation RBI Rate Hike Expectations

Inflation pressures have intensified, prompting analysts to expect the Reserve Bank of India to raise rates, which is influencing the Indian rupee's outlook.

The potential rate hike could affect borrowing costs, currency stability and overall investor sentiment in the Indian market.
